Lemma
[Lower bound for the reduced distance of a Type I solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0170, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0171, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0172 ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-i-reduced-distance-quadratic-upper-growth ↗ cor:chow-iv-type-i-reduced-distance-derivative-bounds 1. ch30:30.17\group Singular-Time Reduced Volume

Under the preceding Type I hypotheses, there is $C<\infty $ such that \[ \sqrt{\ell (x_1,t)+A/B}+\sqrt{\ell (x_2,t)+A/B} \geq \frac{d_{g(t)}(x_1,x_2)}{4\sqrt B\sqrt{\omega -t}}-C. \] In particular, \[ \sqrt{\ell (x,t)+A/B} \geq \frac{d_{g(t)}(x,p)}{4\sqrt B\sqrt{\omega -t}}-C. \]
